ei.title: Chapter 1-02 1번: A Triumph in the Mountains
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: With great care, Robert arranged his instruments. His heart was pounding as he observed the morning shadows gradually descending the mountain. Each adjustment was made thoughtfully, every piece of equipment placed just so, all in anticipation of the cave's hidden entrance being unveiled. He was not sure he could make it. And then, it happened — a subtle flash of light, fleeting yet significant. In that brief moment, Robert captured the crucial data, marking the entrance's location on his map with a surge of triumph. Memories of his grandfather's captivating tales flooded his mind, filling him with a profound sense of connection and joy. Tears welled in his eyes as he settled onto an old log, reflecting on the journey that had led him here. Crying with happiness, he uttered a single word into the crisp mountain air — "Fantastic!"

questions.passage: With great care, Robert (A)[arranged / scattered] his instruments. His heart was pounding as he observed the morning shadows gradually descending the mountain. Each adjustment was made thoughtfully, every piece of equipment placed just so, all in anticipation of the cave's (B)[hidden / obvious] entrance being unveiled. He was not sure he could make it. And then, it happened — a subtle flash of light, fleeting yet significant. In that brief moment, Robert (C)[captured / released] the crucial data, marking the entrance's location on his map with a surge of triumph. Memories of his grandfather's captivating tales flooded his mind, filling him with a profound sense of connection and joy. Tears welled in his eyes as he settled onto an old log, reflecting on the journey that had led him here. Crying with happiness, he uttered a single word into the crisp mountain air — "Fantastic!"
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: Robert는 조심스럽게 기구를 배열(arranged)했고, 동굴의 숨겨진(hidden) 입구를 기대했으며, 결정적 데이터를 포착(captured)했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① arranged — hidden — captured — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② scattered — hidden — captured (A 반대: 배열→흩뿌리다)
❌ ③ arranged — obvious — captured (B 반대: 숨겨진→명백한)
❌ ④ arranged — hidden — released (C 반대: 포착→방출)

questions.passage: With great care, Robert arranged his instruments. His heart was (A)[pounding / calm] as he observed the morning shadows gradually descending the mountain. Each adjustment was made thoughtfully, every piece of equipment placed just so, all in anticipation of the cave's hidden entrance being unveiled. He was not sure he could make it. And then, it happened — a subtle flash of light, fleeting yet significant. In that brief moment, Robert captured the (B)[crucial / trivial] data, marking the entrance's location on his map with a surge of (C)[triumph / defeat]. Memories of his grandfather's captivating tales flooded his mind, filling him with a profound sense of connection and joy. Tears welled in his eyes as he settled onto an old log, reflecting on the journey that had led him here. Crying with happiness, he uttered a single word into the crisp mountain air — "Fantastic!"
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 심장이 두근거리고(pounding), 결정적(crucial) 데이터를 포착했으며, 승리감(triumph)으로 위치를 표시했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① calm — crucial — triumph (A 반대: 두근거리는→차분한)
❌ ② pounding — trivial — triumph (B 반대: 결정적인→사소한)
✅ ③ pounding — crucial — triumph — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ pounding — crucial — defeat (C 반대: 승리→패배)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 미묘한(subtle) 빛의 섬광이었고, 할아버지의 매혹적인(captivating) 이야기가 떠올랐으며, 깊은(profound) 유대감을 느꼈다.

❌ ① glaring — captivating — profound (A 반대: 미묘한→눈부신)
✅ ② subtle — captivating — profound — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ subtle — dull — profound (B 반대: 매혹적인→지루한)
❌ ④ subtle — captivating — shallow (C 반대: 깊은→얕은)

det.korean: '노출된(exposed)'이 아니라 '숨겨진(hidden)'이 문맥상 적절하다. 동굴 입구가 드러나기를 기대했으므로 입구는 숨겨져 있었다.

② observed — 관찰하다, 원문 일치
③ exposed — 원문은 hidden(숨겨진) ←정답

det.analysis:
① thoughtfully — 신중하게, 원문 일치

✅ ④ 이루어지다 — 해내다 ←정답
det.tip: make: (A) be made = 이루어지다/행해지다 vs (B) make it = 해내다/성공하다

questions.passage: With great care, Robert arranged his instruments. His heart was pounding as he observed the morning shadows gradually descending the mountain. Each adjustment was made thoughtfully, every piece of equipment placed just so, all in anticipation of the cave's hidden entrance being unveiled. He was not sure he could make it. And then, it happened — a subtle flash of light, fleeting yet significant. In that brief moment, Robert captured the crucial data, marking the entrance's location on his map with a surge of triumph. Memories of his grandfather's captivating tales flooded his mind, filling him with a profound sense of connection and joy. Tears welled in his eyes as he settled onto an old log, reflecting on __________. Crying with happiness, he uttered a single word into the crisp mountain air — "Fantastic!"
